QuestInfo.name: Mardi Gras Green Masks
QuestInfo.0: Go see #bGaga#k if you want #ra Green Mask#k to wear to the festival!
QuestInfo.1: I'll make you #ra Green Mask#k you can wear to the festival if you bring me #b10 Green Mardi Gras Feathers!#k

0.0: Woohoo! #bMardi Gras Festivals#k are so exciting, aren't they? But wait, where's your mask? You don't have one to wear to the Festival? Oh c'mon, really? Well, if that's the case, would you like me to make you one?

yes.0: Haha! Alright, I'll make you one, since #bGreen Masks#k are my specialty. But! I need the right materials to make it. I tell you what, my friend--since I'm in such a good mood, I'll make you one free of charge if you bring me the goods! All it takes is #r10 Green Mardi Gras Feathers.#k
yes.1: If you bring me all 10, I'll make you a mask you can wear for #r30 days.#k Just so you know, sometimes I get locked into the groove and turn out some ridiculously awesome masks. Of course, I can't guarantee it, but I'm just letting you know. Haha!

no.0: I guess somebody didn't receive the party memo?

1.0: Wow, aren't you quite the diligent Mapler! Well, that's expected of someone who wants to participate in the festival. Here, this is my gift to you.

item.0: You need to bring me #b10 Green Mardi Gras Feathers.#k
